cross_second_copy.checked_behavior: Copy goes to next-second slot499; sparse prefix reaches hole, copy later deleted with bucket.

dual_contiguous_auto_flush.checked_behavior: Equal bucket counts select side0; first paired second stages 500 tokens per side.

paired_primary_hole.checked_behavior: Buzzer traversal stops at primary hole1 although secondary1 exists; both buckets removed.

overwrite_and_late_arrival.checked_behavior: Odd/even adjacent milliseconds address same slot; once loader updates watermark, same-second late data skipped.

shared_request_check_boundary.checked_behavior: With supplied reciprocal masks, side1 consumes request at call1000, not first subsequent sample. A left tick reset requests a right re-anchor; the right side still waits for its own check.

clock_rollback_to_loader_recovery.checked_behavior: Mapper rebase alone leaves old watermark; 500 severely-old enqueue attempts reset it, next epoch can insert.

capacity_retry.checked_behavior: 11th novel bucket forces one loader/encode opportunity before retry; missing peer uses single-side fallback.

unsigned_tick_wrap.checked_behavior: Tick decrease causes check, but uint32 subtraction keeps mapped relative256; no >2s error, no rebase.

secondary_uses_primary_output_slot.checked_behavior: Output destination derives from primary relative; secondary shares array slot selection, no waveform correlation.

older_than_earliest_pending.checked_behavior: Below earliest pending key skips even before any loader watermark exists.

limits: Only buzzer staging; no claim of full encoder/network/cloud output.
No actual ADC/IMU values, physical clocks or hardware gain.
Reciprocal shared masks and event scheduling are explicit scenario inputs; deployed wiring not established.
No asynchronous interleavings, output-error propagation, or IMU/extADC/multi-channel early-break coupling.
